description: Closed failure and retry matrix for source-session-handoff v1.0. retryable is true only for dependency_unavailable. That outcome is never success, an empty context, or an unscoped redirect.

outcomes.meaning: The peer object failed structural validation. Retrying the same bytes cannot succeed.
Issuer, audience, receiver, client, or destination binding did not match, or the source attestation was revoked. Hash equality is not a substitute.
The code window or context lifetime was inverted, non-positive, longer than the profile maximum, or elapsed. A new handoff is required.
The authorization code or handoff was already consumed. Reconciliation must not create a second receiver session.
Subject, organisation, account, role, session, or context was missing, browser-authored, forged, or not bound to the issuer attestation.
Record scope was empty, duplicated, wildcarded, ambiguous, or not an explicit subset of the initiation request.
Source role and permission bounds were treated as receiver access. This contract does not grant that access.
The contract family, contract version, or profile is not the published v1.0 pair. Fail closed.
A required dependency could not be reached. Retry may reconcile the same attempt only. It must not become success, an empty context, an unscoped redirect, or a second receiver session.
